own_body.title: Application settings
own_body.summary: The application features tabs on the top menu bar, which vary based on the permissions assigned to the user's group in the Configurator application.

children.title: Change the system mode
children.summary: The section explains how to switch the system mode between automatic and autonomous via a click action, noting that the current mode is displayed on the top bar. It defines automatic mode as allowing management by the Qursor M.A.P. system with tasks triggered at stations, and autonomous mode as restricting management to station triggers, tablet applications, or other automation systems, where tasks cannot be triggered within the Qursor M.A.P. application.

children.title: Open Configurator application 2
children.summary: Qursor Configurator is an application used to configure the Qursor system in the target environment by defining use cases, stations, tasks, build strings, AGVs, sequences, and products.

children.title: User settings
children.summary: The section describes actions available in the user settings, including checking the logged-in user's name, changing the application language, enabling the virtual keyboard, refreshing the page, or logging out.
